authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-131 preview non-authoritative analyze product contract. It applies nothing, edits no register row, seals nothing, marks nothing SATISFIED, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. D-056 Class A is not opened. File 12 has no authority.
purpose: Answer every fragment of the live DR-131 acceptance-evidence cell as a stated obligation. Freeze the pack identity and analyze laws. Do not freeze rule IR, evaluation algorithm, packaging, or default numeric constants.

registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-131 |'. Compare row text, not a remembered line number.
registerRowQuoted.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Independently reviewed contract that freezes: single first-party bundled declarative pack name/version; sealed facts+Coverage inputs; PlanId membership of the pack; core-evaluated `policyOutcome`; typed-indeterminate on a missing required rung; which preview identities are unstable; upgrade path to a sealed Run; citation of D-077 / D-078. The cell excludes human/machine JSON schema and exit generics already SATISFIED at DR-123 (D-092).

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: single first-party bundled declarative pack name/version
obligationDecomposition.readAs: Exactly one host-owned bundled first-party declarative pack, named and versioned here. No user or third-party packs.
Analyze evaluation consumes only host-admitted TypeScript facts and Coverage. Component findings are not inputs.
Pack name and version are PlanId members. This contract freezes membership, not the §7.1 producing rule.
The pack threshold is evaluated in the pure core as policyOutcome. Host does not mint fail/warn or a D9 code.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: typed-indeterminate on a missing required rung
obligationDecomposition.readAs: A missing required semantic rung is typed Coverage-indeterminate. Silent syntax fallback is forbidden.
Preview output identities listed as unstable or conceptual. No durable finding identity. SARIF not advertised.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: upgrade path to a sealed Run
obligationDecomposition.readAs: Same admission/PlanIntent can later produce a sealed Run once recipes exist. Preview result is not that Run.
D-077 and D-078 are cited as the identity and D9 preview dispositions. This contract invents neither recipes nor D9 codes.

obligationDecomposition.cellFragmentVerbatim: The cell excludes human/machine JSON schema and exit generics already SATISFIED at DR-123 (D-092).
obligationDecomposition.readAs: DR-123 (D-092) already SATISFIES human/machine JSON schema and exit generics. This cell does not re-own them.

pack.name: opensip.preview.typescript.pack
pack.rule: Exactly one pack. Host-owned. Bundled. First-party. Declarative-only. Over TypeScript facts admitted under DR-133. No user packs. No third-party packs.

inputs.facts: Only host-admitted semantic facts from the preview TypeScript provider (DR-133 / provider-only-output-contract.v3).
inputs.coverage: Only host-admitted Coverage. The provider does not choose sufficiency.
inputs.sealed: Facts and Coverage are sealed inputs to the pure core. The core has no effectful ports.

planIdMembership.statement: The pack's name and version are analysis-affecting inputs and are members of PlanId.
planIdMembership.reason: Freeze §7.1 parks PlanId-affecting producing rules. This contract freezes membership, not the digest recipe. Preview analyze must not invent a PlanId producing rule.

policy.d9Owner: DR-007 / d9-exit-contract.v1.14. Host maps only existing v1.14 classes.

missingRung.rule: An unavailable required semantic rung is typed Coverage-indeterminate.
missingRung.forbidden: Silent syntactic fallback as if the missing rung were sufficient (C-1 / freeze law 3).

notDurable: RunId as a sealed authoritative identity
unstableIdentities.doctorD9: Maps only what D9 v1.14 already states. Does not close observation→faultCause.

upgradePath.previewResult: Non-authoritative terminal analyze result. Not a sealed Run. Not an authoritative gate (D-018).
upgradePath.whenRecipesExist: The same admitted PlanIntent may produce a sealed Run. Sealed identity is added then. Preview correlation IDs are not that identity.
upgradePath.noSilentPromotion: A preview result must not be relabeled as a sealed Run without the recipes and an authoritative seal path.

d077.citedLaw: SARIF drops; cache keys, Coverage, and PlanId stay conceptual. Binding recipes remain owed.

d078.citedLaw: Invents no D9 code. Doctor D9 mapping ships reduced, re-scoped, or waits.

dr133.role: Facts and Coverage only from the TypeScript provider. Findings are host-owned.

dr117.role: Preview install shape: core + host + TypeScript closure + this pack identity. This artifact names the pack; it does not invent pack IR.

dr123.governs: Stable human/machine JSON schema and exit generics for first-slice core commands.
dr123.thisContractMustNot: Re-own or restate those generics as DR-131 SATISFIED evidence.

NT-1.name: user-or-third-party-pack-refused
NT-1.input: An analyze request that names a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1, or supplies a user/third-party pack.
NT-1.pass: Request refused at admission. No evaluation.

NT-2.name: imperative-rule-refused
NT-2.input: A pack or contribution that is not declarative-only.
NT-2.pass: Refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded.

NT-3.name: missing-rung-not-success
NT-3.input: Required TypeScript semantic universe cannot be constructed.
NT-3.pass: Typed Coverage-indeterminate. Not authoritative success. No silent syntax fallback.

NT-4.name: component-finding-not-analyze-finding
NT-4.input: Provider payload that would be a finding under file 01's general may-return.
NT-4.pass: Refused under DR-133. Analyze findings, if any, come only from host-owned rules over admitted facts.

NT-5.name: sarif-not-advertised
NT-5.input: A request or flag that advertises SARIF 2.1.0 for preview analyze.
NT-5.pass: Refused or not offered. D-077 drop stands.

NT-6.name: preview-result-not-sealed-run
NT-6.input: A consumer treats the preview terminal result as a sealed authoritative Run.
NT-6.pass: The contract forbids that label. No silent promotion.
